README 新增中文说明和双语技能目录
Added attribution to original source (github.com/slavingia/skills by Sahil Lavingia) and README documentation

- Initial release of the company-values skill based on The Minimalist Entrepreneur philosophy
- Guides users to define meaningful, non-generic company values before hiring
- Includes frameworks, real-world examples, and step-by-step prompts to draft unique company values
- Covers operationalizing values in communication, hiring, and daily work
- Offers guidance for remote work culture and accountability
- Provides examples from Gumroad and other minimalist companies to inspire users
